analyst_guardrails.authentication_abuse: Repeated failed authentication followed by success may indicate credential guessing or user error. It does not prove credential compromise.
analyst_guardrails.object_authorization: Requests for unauthorized objects indicate attempted access outside the user's expected scope. Denied requests do not prove successful exploitation.
analyst_guardrails.token_reuse: Use of the same token from multiple source IP addresses may indicate token sharing, network changes, proxy use, or token misuse. It does not prove token theft.
analyst_guardrails.object_enumeration: Rapid sequential object requests may indicate automated enumeration or scripted access. The pattern alone does not prove exploitation.
analyst_guardrails.administrative_access: A non-administrator requesting an administrative endpoint represents unauthorized function access. A denied request does not prove administrative compromise.
analyst_guardrails.rate_abuse: High request volume may represent automation, legitimate application behavior, or abuse. Rate alone does not establish malicious intent.
